title: Dolphin Huge 4,080 SqFt cul-de-sac Home
description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place in the East Valley. Water Park and golf are just minutes away. This property has 3 family rooms. One of the rooms is a separate studio apartment great or old guest that need their own space or a young couple with a baby. Every bedroom has its own tv so it will be comfortable for everyone. The back yard is being remodel and is not accessible which is why such a large home is at such a great price. ID is required
review_snippets: Had a great time my bridesmaids and I stayed there the night before the wedding. It was great!
We loved this place. it was so different and unique and there's a lot of space.

The house itself was great very spacious the host was responsive but the house was vey dirty our feet turned black walking around inside the couches had never been cleaned dust and dirt was bad. We spent half a day cleaning the house the tubs did not drain so you were in a foot of water by the time you were done showering. It could have been a great stay if we didn’t have to waste time cleaning
Thank you so much! We enjoyed our stay!
There for a soccer tournament.  We won.  Core memories. Kids loved the pool table, chess, foosball and ping pong.

Though we had a great stay, the overal cleanliness and quality was less than we usually get at Airbnb. I realize that some remodeling went on but that should not effect cleansiness inside the home. The house needs a thorough clean and some furniture needs to be replaced..
